title: The Park Record’s Magical Typesetting Machine
lineage: Museum retrospective with attributed Park Record quotations; original 1915 newspaper issue not independently inspected. Author also reports a firsthand 2015 visit.

passages.locator: Park Record Junior and Model K paragraphs
passages.note: Reports 1909 Junior breakdowns and quotes a 1915 account of disposal; says a Model K replaced it by January 1914 and quotes a year of operation in 1915.
Describes a firsthand 2015 visit and reports that Dean Coombs still operated the old Linotype at the time of writing.
